title: Token display at a school canteen
body: A school canteen uses a small display system that keeps the token numbers of waiting students in a queue. The display can hold at most 4 token numbers at a time, so the queue has a fixed capacity of 4. The system does not call IS FULL or IS EMPTY before an operation. During the lunch break the following operations are performed, in this order, on an initially empty queue: (1) enqueue(101) (2) enqueue(102) (3) dequeue() (4) enqueue(103) (5) enqueue(104) (6) enqueue(105) (7) enqueue(106) (8) dequeue().
